name: Shopify
description: Ecommerce: hosted online-store platform with Admin/Storefront APIs for products, orders, customers, inventory and fulfillment.
access_notes: Developers create apps for free in the Shopify Dev Dashboard; free development stores are available via a dev account. Merchants can also generate admin-created custom app access tokens directly in the Shopify admin. All tokens are sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token.
mcp_notes: Shopify ships multiple official MCP servers: Dev MCP (npm @shopify/dev-mcp, docs/schema tooling) and a hosted Storefront MCP endpoint per store ({shop}.myshopify.com/api/mcp), plus Customer Accounts MCP. Composio also has a Shopify toolkit (API_KEY, OAUTH2, S2S_OAUTH2).
uncertainty_notes: GraphQL Admin API is the primary surface for new apps; REST Admin API is legacy but still served. Offline access tokens are transitioning to expiring tokens with refresh tokens.

evidence.note: Official auth overview: authorization code grant, token exchange, admin-generated access tokens for custom apps.
OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant for org-owned server-to-server apps; token endpoint at {shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token.
GraphQL Admin API reference; all requests use X-Shopify-Access-Token header; broad read+write objects (products, orders, customers, etc.).
Self-serve tutorial: create app in Dev Dashboard, get client ID/secret, exchange for access tokens programmatically.
Official shopify.dev docs for the Shopify Dev MCP server (npx @shopify/dev-mcp).
Composio Shopify toolkit page exists; lists auth (API_KEY, OAUTH2, S2S_OAUTH2) and hundreds of tool slugs like SHOPIFY_BULK_CREATE_PRODUCTS.
